mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_outbox ( id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, event_version, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, published_time, last_error, create_by, update_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{eventVersion}, #{routingKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{publishedTime}, #{lastError}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, event_version, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, published_time, last_error, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted FROM event_outbox WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'SENDING'

UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{retryDelaySeconds} SECOND), last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'SENDING'

UPDATE event_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', next_retry_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = '发布进程中断，已自动恢复', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'SENDING' AND update_time < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
